newsitem.title: POLAND: Poland offers PLN 150 mln one-year bonds on Nov 26.
newsitem.headline: Poland offers PLN 150 mln one-year bonds on Nov 26.

text.p: The Polish treasury is offering to sell 150 million zlotys of one-year index-linked bonds on November 26, 1996, the National Bnak of Poland said.
The base interest rate of the paper, maturing on December 3, 1997, is the cumulated inflation rate of 12 months.
The value date for this auction is December 2, 1996.
The paper comes from the third tranche of a 1.6 billion zloty issue. At the last auction of the bonds on October 29, 1996, the minimum price was 95.00 and the average accepted price was 95.99.
